title: Runtime Receipt
description: modeller-agents-owned OUTBOUND contract for a partial/terminal execution receipt, authored to match testudo-backend's DRAFT, non-final contracts/runtime-receipt.schema.json (marked a design fixture, not a final generated API schema, per testudo-backend/12-api-event-and-schema-catalog.md section 8). modeller-agents is named Producer of RuntimeReceipt in that document's section 7 contract-catalog table. This schema mirrors, but does not copy verbatim, the testudo-backend draft's required-field set. LIMITATION: if the parallel testudo-backend mission changes the real RuntimeReceipt shape before this schema is consumed, this file must be RE-VERSIONED (schema_version bump), not silently reinterpreted to match the new shape.
x-additional-properties-rationale: Unlike mission-identity.schema.json / checkpoint-receipt.schema.json (additionalProperties:true, pre-existing defensive/extensible internal records), this schema defines modeller-agents' own outbound wire shape authored specifically to match a real, named external consumer (testudo-backend Gateway/Task) -- so unexpected fields are a producer-side contract bug, not forward-compatible extension, and additionalProperties:false is deliberate here.

pipeline_execution_id.description: Opaque, pattern-constrained correlation-ID token binding this receipt to a testudo-backend pipeline execution. modeller-agents does not own or interpret its internal structure -- same style as mission_id/task_id in schemas/mission-identity.schema.json (Q1 disposition: opaque correlation field, not schema ownership).
